 Roma consider Alejandro Balde to add squad depth
 Andy Mattioli
 11 seconds ago 
 (Photo by Daniela Porcelli/Getty Images) 
 In January, Tony D’Amico will be tasked with satisfying the demands of Gian Piero Gasperini, who has publicly stated that his squad is short. 
 Roma’s sporting director agrees with the coach, which is why he’s already working to best plan the next transfer window. He has two objectives: a striker and a central midfielder. 
 In addition to Oosterwolde, the new name is Barcelona’s Balde. The 2003-born player has already played 170 games for the Spanish club, but this season he’s not finding much playing time under Hans-Dieter Flick.
 The left-back is finding little playing time at Barcelona, ​​which is why he could leave in January. 
 As reported by Il Messaggero, given his limited playing time with Flick, Mendes, the 2003-born player’s agent (the same as Rodrigo Mora), has offered him to the Giallorossi. It remains to be seen what developments will take place in the coming weeks.
